scope: AMEP-1 research software / SIL assurance traceability. This matrix is not certification, type approval, or operational maritime evidence.

requirements.statement: The default runtime policy shall fail closed until behavior-affecting configuration has been validated and sealed.
A sealed runtime shall detect post-seal configuration drift and block data processing.
requirements.claim_boundary: In-process configuration fingerprinting; not cryptographic configuration attestation.

requirements.statement: Safety-relevant estimator, source, timing, consistency, and watchdog configuration shall reject non-finite numeric values.
requirements.claim_boundary: Input-contract validation only; it does not validate vessel-specific tuning.

requirements.statement: Normalized measurement covariance shall be finite, symmetric, correctly dimensioned, and positive definite before estimator fusion.
requirements.claim_boundary: Software covariance contract only; it does not establish real sensor covariance calibration.

requirements.statement: DEGRADED absolute sources may contribute to the local information-rank heuristic but shall not receive healthy-source navigation-authority credit.
requirements.claim_boundary: Reference SIL authority policy; not certified maritime safety logic.

requirements.statement: A dependency-disjoint cross-source absolute-position contradiction shall be rejected before fusion and latched until the configured recovery evidence threshold is satisfied.
requirements.claim_boundary: Synthetic consistency-monitor behavior; it does not identify the faulty source or prove spoofing detection.

requirements.statement: GPS_DENIED_RESILIENT authority shall require the configured count of dependency-disjoint, safety-credit, ONLINE non-GNSS absolute sources.
requirements.claim_boundary: Declared dependency model and SIL policy only; source independence is an engineering assumption, not statistical proof.

requirements.statement: Replay evidence shall be deterministically serializable and tamper-evident through the published hash-chain contract.
requirements.claim_boundary: Software tamper evidence only; not a digital signature, trusted clock, or classified audit mechanism.

requirements.statement: The replaceable inertial backend shall represent a local-level strapdown nominal state with three-axis position, velocity, attitude, accelerometer bias, gyroscope bias, and a 15-state error covariance, including gravity, Earth-rate/Coriolis terms, covariance propagation, innovation screening, and Joseph-form measurement updates.
requirements.claim_boundary: Reference SIL mechanization only; noise values are not IMU-calibrated and no target-hardware or vessel performance claim is made.

requirements.statement: The SIL integrity research layer shall derive fault hypotheses from declared source dependencies, support explicit per-hypothesis integrity-risk bookkeeping, evaluate covariance-aware horizontal solution separation, and summarize false-alert, missed-detection, and time-to-alert trial metrics.
requirements.claim_boundary: Generic SIL FDE framework only; hypotheses are not a verified vessel fault tree and the outputs are not validated protection levels.

requirements.statement: Sensor installation contracts shall carry lever-arm, boresight, latency, calibration provenance, and calibration covariance, and shall support rigid-body velocity correction with first-order uncertainty propagation.
requirements.claim_boundary: Software calibration-data contract only; the repository does not provide measured platform installation values or validate the survey procedure.

requirements.statement: The reference NMEA 0183 adapter shall validate checksums, parse selected navigation sentence families, frame bounded byte streams, and normalize supported observations into timestamped covariance-bearing MeasurementEnvelope records.
requirements.claim_boundary: Software sentence/stream normalization only; no IEC 61162 electrical, serial-bus, or vessel-interface conformity claim is made.
